Build a palette scale by name

Source: R/networkplot.R, R/utils-palette.R
pal_scale.Rd

Internal helper that looks up scale_<aesthetic>_<pal>() in ggsci and calls it, so any palette in your installed version of ggsci can be used. Use pal = "default" to get ggplot2's default discrete or continuous scale instead.

Internal helper that looks up scale_<aesthetic>_<pal>() in ggsci and calls it, so any palette in your installed version of ggsci can be used. Use pal = "default" to get ggplot2's default discrete or continuous scale instead.

Usage

pal_scale(aesthetic, pal, type = "discrete", ...)

pal_scale(aesthetic, pal, type = "discrete", ...)

Arguments

aesthetic

"fill" or "colour"/"color"

pal

ggsci palette name, e.g. "npg", "lancet", "gsea", or "default" for the ggplot2 default

type

"discrete" or "continuous". For ggsci palettes this is used for validation only; for pal = "default" it picks which ggplot2 scale to use.

...

passed on to the scale (e.g. palette = "category20", alpha = 0.8, reverse = TRUE for ggsci; any ggplot2 scale argument such as name or limits for the default)

Value

a ggplot2 scale

a ggplot2 scale
